Windows cdrdao runtime components

The four DLLs in cdrdao126.zip match the following MSYS2 binary packages
byte-for-byte (SHA256 values and upstream URLs: runtime-components.json):

msys-2.0.dll: msys2-runtime 3.6.5-1. The Cygwin runtime uses LGPL v3 or
later with the linking exception in LICENSE.msys2-runtime.txt. Additional
newlib notices are retained in COPYING.newlib.txt.

msys-gcc_s-seh-1.dll and msys-stdc++-6.dll: gcc-libs 15.2.0-1.
Copyright (C) Free Software Foundation, Inc. GPL v3 or later with GCC
Runtime Library Exception 3.1. See COPYING.GPLv3.txt and
COPYING.GCC-exception.txt. File-specific notices remain in the sources.

msys-iconv-2.dll: libiconv 1.18-1.
Copyright (C) 1999-2024 Free Software Foundation, Inc.
LGPL v2.1 or later; see COPYING.libiconv.txt.

Corresponding MSYS2 source packages include upstream sources, patches and
PKGBUILD instructions. Checksums and download locations are recorded in
vendor/distribution-sources.json in the Karaoke Toolkit source repository:
https://github.com/Adna1206/karaoke-toolkit

Maintainers: scripts/Prepare-DistributionSources.ps1 assembles source evidence.
The overall FFmpeg source inventory is still incomplete. These references
do not represent a written source offer or public-distribution clearance.
Redistributors must supply the required matching sources with their release
using a method permitted by the respective licences.
